messages.subject: Julia | Energy Transition Executive | External Affairs, ESG & Strategic Partnerships
messages.body:
Dear Julia,

I am contacting you because your Talent Acquisition remit across South East Europe at Siemens Energy aligns closely with the industrial and energy-transition environments I am targeting internationally.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My work covers government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate and external affairs, strategic stakeholder engagement and executive communications across a large-scale mining operation.

My current portfolio also includes stakeholder governance around approximately 46-50 MWp of solar capacity, more than 80 MWh of battery storage and carbon-data readiness. This gives me direct exposure to the operating, institutional and sustainability issues surrounding industrial decarbonization.

I am pursuing Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates across External Affairs, Government Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Stakeholder Relations and Country Leadership. I am open to relocation, expatriate and regional assignments across Europe and the Middle East.

I have attached a Siemens Energy-tailored executive CV and would value consideration for suitable current or upcoming leadership mandates.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
